item.title: Worship with Joy, Walk in Unity, and Pray for Peace: Reflections on Psalm 122
item.description: Dave Jenkins teaches Psalm 122, showing how worship is joyful, unity is rooted in Christ, and true peace comes through Jesus Christ, not false peace, false unity, or worldly political solutions.

item.title: Finishing Well by Guarding Holiness, Nehemiah 13
item.description: In Nehemiah 13, Nehemiah returns to find God’s people drifting back into compromise. This episode calls believers to finish well by guarding holiness, restoring worship, honoring God’s commands, and seeking mercy through Christ who cleanses and restores His people.

item.title: Why “Born Innocent” Is a Dangerous Lie, Recovering the Doctrine of Sin
item.description: Many evangelicals believe people are born innocent, but Scripture teaches otherwise. This episode explains why denying original sin distorts the gospel and undermines grace in Christ alone.

item.title: Nehemiah Conclusion, The Faithful God Who Rebuilds Hearts
item.description: In this concluding episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins reflects on the book of Nehemiah and its central theme of God’s faithfulness in rebuilding and restoring His people. This episode highlights spiritual renewal, leadership rooted in prayer, the centrality of God’s Word, repentance, joyful worship, and how Nehemiah ultimately points us to Christ, the true restorer of broken hearts.
